description:
`Terminal.feed_chunk/2` is public in production. Tests use it
to inject stdin bytes without a real tty, but there's nothing
stopping production callers from synthesizing input.

Options:
1. Mark `@doc false` + move the test uses behind a
   `OctoPi.TUI.TestSupport.Terminal` helper module (pattern
   matches `OctoPi.Agent.TestSupport.FakeTransport`).
2. Keep public, add a clear moduledoc paragraph on intended
   use.

Prefer (1) — same as the FakeTransport precedent. Minor
refactor, ~30 LOC test-side.

TDD:
- Existing tests keep passing after the helper move.
title: Terminal.feed_chunk: scope to test-support only
